_comment: Optional. Copy to data/worker-settings.json to attach external guardrails to worker-mode Claude. This is a native Claude Code settings.json — Clack forwards it verbatim to the Agent SDK. Paths must be ABSOLUTE and resolve INSIDE the runtime environment (GCE VM / Docker image), not your laptop; any referenced binaries + prerequisites (e.g. jq, bash) must be installed there. Absent → worker runs exactly as before.
_comment_enforcement: The worker runs in bypassPermissions mode, so permissions allow/deny rules are SKIPPED. Use PreToolUse hooks for hard enforcement — hooks fire even under bypass. Keep hard blocks in the hook (a PreToolUse hook returning a deny decision blocks the call).
